notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/30eedd05ce83dcbbe7513cc026fcf4c60e4c04a7.jpg

Hail Knights,

During this server maintenance;


 Some typos have been edited.
 Fixed some graphical issues with bridges and towers on the Ronark Land map.
 Fixed the issue where some creatures' weapons were lost when the shader (graphics) setting was changed.
 The coin drop rate of the creatures Fierce Red Dragon, Bathin, Garlong and Marsil on the Eslant map has been reduced.

The Dryad Spirit item has been discontinued on PUS.

1st Players -> Switching Premium for 30 Days
2nd Players -> War Premium for 30 Days
3rd Players -> Bronze Premium for 30 Days

Have fun!
NTTGame | Knight Online Team

notes.title: The Thanksgiving Feastival Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/e25ee32da2b3019f33d658ab485be3569f74c5ed.png

Hail Knights!
The Thanksgiving Feastival season is arriving with new activities for you to take part on while you stay in the Adonis Continent. Make the most out of your stay by enjoying this content update arriving on 11/07/2018!

NEW QUESTS!

The Stolen Thanksgiving Food
Defeat the evil monsters that stole the Thanksgiving food and snatch some of the items they took from the store! 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/50c036cd2ca3188c4b1e78a7f090f90275570e27.gif

Collect the Thanksgiving Boxes!
Participate in the events such as BDW, Juraid, Forgotten Temple and Chaos to obtain Thanksgiving boxes! Collect enough and redeem epic rewards in-game!

And, if you spend the most amount of boxes…there will be even more epic rewards before the end of November via one of our Twitch broadcasts! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/25888bb81bc96bbce64e708a7f4e735dce3d8c59.gif

It’s Time To DU-EL!
The minigame YUT comes to Moradon! If you win enough “Golden Yuts” you may have a chance at redeeming great prizes at random! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/d96e4c15fde915ebb15db63651fc4983db99f615.gif

Rage of the Lunar Rabbit
It seems that the Thanksgiving Feastival has harvested too much from the lands of the Adonis Continent and the “Raged Lunar Rabbit” is now lurking in Mora Island! Defeat him for a chance to obtain mysterious prizes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/7fb8aed2a519873166b031ab958f8ad71c68a465.png

QUESTS RESET ENGAGED!
Have you completed all the quests in The Adonis Continent?
Are you still maxed out in levels and have the desire to continue questing? 
This season we will be resetting all quests, so you can obtain extra experience!

[Saving Michelle and Sid / Gift of Bilbor / 1st Job Change / 2nd Job Change / Skill Quests / Achievement Quests will NOT be reset]!

We hope to see you soon!

notes.title: Update Regarding the Recent Outage 5/19/2017
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!

We have some information regarding the outage and I wanted to share it with you all so you can be aware of the situation. 

The problem the servers have been having is related to the Data Center, or more specifically how the game communicates with the Data center. Resulting in highly unstable connections and causing the outages you’ve been experiencing. 

All-important data related to your characters is secure, there is no risk of characters being lost. If there is data loss, it will be related to the last few days since the issue started. 

We are doing our best to resolve this issue and restore service as soon as possible. There will be compensation for the time lost as a result of the outage as well, which will be determined once we have service restored. 

We as a team thank you all for your patience and support. We’re just as hungry to get back into the game as you guys, and as new information becomes available we will make further announcements. 

Thank you, 
The Knight Online Team.

notes.title: Steam Chargeback Users [Ban Release]
notes.notes:
Greetings Knights!

We have been contacted by several users due to the ban imposed by Valve Anti-fraud protection system regarding charge-backs which also caused them to be banned from Knight Online. 

Upon further investigation and communication with Steam, we have been able to do the following:

Valve
- As notified by Steam Support, all the spent currency within Steam Knight Online was returned to your Steam Wallet and/or Payment gateway.

Steam Knight Online
- All users who have contacted us with proof of release by Steam followed by us verifying such information with Valve are now able to play Knight Online as their ban has now been lifted.

- The items your purchased through our PUS prior to the ban, "Mostly Premiums" have been removed as you were refunded the charged amount by Steam.

If you are one of those who have been affected by a Steam Ban followed by Knight Online ban due to chargebacks. Please make sure to contact Steam support and send us the details of your release.

We thank you for your patience, and we are glad to have resolved this issue for several players.

Best Regards,
NTTGame Support Staff

notes.title: [Hotfix] New Patch Now Available for Download! 01/28/2016
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
We've been hard at work preparing updates and improvements to our servers so you're able to enjoy Knight Online with ease. 
We want your Knight experience to be a memorable one and we are gathering all the users feedback and preparing quality of life improvements! 

We have now implemented a new downloadable patch and this is what you have to do to obtain it:
- Disconnect completely from Knight Online
- Make sure your Knight Online game Updates
- Download Update
- PLAY THE GAME!

What this update includes

INVISIBLE WINGS!
You can now Hide all the Wings from the game!
We all know there's a lot of hot wings out there running around and sometimes even preventing you from talking to some NPCs. 
This shall no longer be a problem!

How to make the wings invisible/visible: [View attached image]
http://i.imgur.com/jMqSUVR.png

Error Data Gathering
Any problem logging in to or terminating Knight Online will bring a pop-up that will send the error information directly to our dev team to make sure they are instantly aware of  your issues!

XignCode Errors troubleshooting
Many of you have been reporting Xingcode issues. This can be caused by launching the game with passion instead of letting Steam load first.

If you are experiencing this issue, do the following:
- Close Steam Completely
- Open Steam and Sign in
- Make sure that Knight Online is updated and it's ready to be played
- Click on Knight Online
- PLAY!
[Sometimes users are affected by this issue by click spamming Knight Online without waiting for Xigncode to load properly]

Many more quality of life improvements will come soon! 
We appreciate all the support you're giving us!
